Lessons: Choosing a Translation and Getting Started; Read in Context; Observe, Interpret, Apply; Studying Different Kinds of Scripture; Using Cross-References and Word Studies; Praying Through What You Read; Building a Lasting Habit
Description: You do not need a theology degree to understand Scripture — you just need a simple, steady method. This practical course gives you tools you can use the very same day, so Bible reading stops feeling confusing and starts feeling nourishing. Bring your questions; everyone learns here.
